notes.title: Update v0.5.12
notes.notes:
Today we added a new building items along with a few quality of life features. This will be the last update of the play test as we prepare for Early Access.

The Porch Update brings railings and support beams into the building system. They are constructed with Cedar board and nails, can be placed on all foundations and wall types, and support the existing roof types. The support beams will also hold floors to allowing second story building with a couple boards rather than full wall construction.

The raid system has also been updated, now only occurring at night, remaining completely avoidable if gone to sleep or turned off in the settings. An additional reward has been added if you can make it to the ship and loot the raid treasure before the entities find you.

The damage of the raid entities has increased and the auto health regeneration has decrease.

The entity loot boxes as well as all cloud shipping packages now auto pickup when you are near. The size has also been increased to help find in the grass.

Thanks again to everyone that has play tested Gone Upstate and excited for further updates as we launch into Early Access.

*Health regeneration decrease
*Raid Entity Damage Increase
*Added Raid Reward on Ship
*Collecting raid reward finishes raid
*Shipping box UI item indicator
*Cursor disable after menu fix
*Left Click mouse icon indicator
*Support Posts Build Piece added
*Support Railings Build Piece added
*Cedar Railings Build Piece added
*Increased Entity Loot box size
*Added auto pick up for all loot shipping boxes
*Respawn at bus stop button added
